description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'NullMetadata' which implements the 'Metadata' interface. It represents a JSON null value within the Ditto modeling framework, providing methods to handle JSON nulls and related operations.

classes.name: NullMetadata
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON null value within the Ditto framework, implementing the Metadata interface. Provides methods for handling JSON null semantics and operations.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of NullMetadata implementing Metadata.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this Metadata is not a boolean.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this Metadata is not a number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this Metadata is not an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this Metadata is not a long.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this Metadata is not a double.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this Metadata is not a string.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this Metadata represents a JSON object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this Metadata is not an array.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this Metadata is a JSON null.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as null cannot be converted to boolean.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as null cannot be converted to int.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as null cannot be converted to long.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as null cannot be converted to double.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as null cannot be converted to string.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the JsonObject representing this null metadata.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as null cannot be an array.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a new value with given name and int/long/double/bool/string/JsonValue, returning new ImmutableMetadata.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field or all fields with given JsonFieldDefinition or JsonField, returning new ImmutableMetadata.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Returns false, as null does not contain any key.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional as null has no stored values.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns this NullMetadata object, regardless of JsonPointer, JsonFieldDefinition, or JsonFieldSelector passed.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Returns this NullMetadata object after removal attempt.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns an empty list, null has no keys.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns Optional.empty as null has no fields.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an empty iterator over JsonFields.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the NullMetadata has no data.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns 0, as there are no fields.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an empty Stream of JsonField.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns the wrapped JsonObject representing null.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the null JSON value into the provided SerializationContext.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Returns the size upper bound for the JSON null literal.
